answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 2357 Country: Pakistan Title: What is the opinion of the islamic jurists about the effects of masturbation on fasting? Question: What is the opinion of the islamic jurists about the effects of masturbation on fasting? Answer ID: 2357 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1297/178=B) Masturbation nullifies fast and makes it invalid. One has to make qaza (makeup) it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
